items.title: 68190_Samuel
items.q: Buck Clayton, yeah, he was emceeing the deal at Carnegie Hall there and he called my name twice, man.

ctx.x: Buck Clayton, yeah, he was emceeing the deal at Carnegie Hall there and he called my name twice, man. I mean the first time he called it I didn't hear. Joe and I were down there [running] and he called it again and I still didn't get up there so I didn't have a chance to get introduced. Boy I sure hated that too, boy, but anyway, he told them about me anyway.
That's great, Baby. Now that's the first I've heard of this.
